product_metadata.title: Lotus Anti-Collision Window Clings - Glass Alert Prism Decals - Prevent Birds Strikes – Decorate Your Glass Doors, 4 Packs, JDLH-4-2
features: 【SAVE YOUR BIRDS】- Birds won’t see glass, these decals can help birds notice the glass, stop birds from hitting windows & sliding doors, and save your beautiful feathered friends. Package includes 4 packs of lotus decals and comes in individual parts. You need to put the individual parts together like the style you see. The entire size of the style is about 19″ tall and 9.6″ wide.

【RAINBOW MAKER/SUNCATCHER】- These prism-design decals can not only be used as a bird deterrent, but also act as a great home and office décor. They can reflect sunlight and create beautiful rainbow to your room.

【NO GLUE,NO MESS】- These decals are static clings. Just peel off the transparent backing paper, spray some water on glass surface, and stick the smooth side of the clings to glass. It is recommended to apply outside, but you can still install it inside if your window is too high. . Before installation, make sure your surface is clean and free of any tinting, film, coating and other ornaments.
【REUSABLE, REPOSITIONABLE,CLEANABLE】- You can remove them if you need to wash your window, and reinstall them after washing. These clings can be cleaned with water too.

【QUALITY AND MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE】- Our clings are made of premium prism film, thicker and more colorful. We offer 6 months over-long customer service, shopping with no worry. IF YOU ARE NOT SATISFIED WITH OUR PRODUCTS, PLEASE FEEL FREE TO LET US KNOW, REFUND GUARANTEE WITH NO QUESTION ASKED.
